question: For each port status, show the status and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the ports’ standard attribute IDs, considering only ports that have a security group port binding and a port security binding, and excluding shared networks (i.e., excluding networks that have an RBAC entry with action = 'access_as_shared' for target tenant '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'). Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.status,
       STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation
FROM ports AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgb WHERE sgb.port_id = p.id
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM portsecuritybindings AS psb WHERE psb.port_id = p.id
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM networkrbacs AS r
    WHERE r.object_id = p.network_id
      AND r.action = 'access_as_shared'
      AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
  )
GROUP BY p.status;
